---
name: 🛠️ Refactor Proposal
about: Propose code cleanups, design pattern improvements, or structural refactoring
title: "[REFACTOR]: "
labels: ["refactor", "needs review"]
---

## Description

Summary of code smells, technical debt, or anti-patterns targeted for refactoring.

## Motivation & Benefits

Why is this refactoring beneficial? (e.g., improves readability, testability, maintainability, type safety).

## Scope & Target Modules

List the specific modules, schemas, or components affected.

## Backward Compatibility

Does this refactoring change internal APIs, database models, or external endpoint contracts?

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Refactored code maintains existing runtime behavior.
- [ ] No regression in test suite coverage.
- [ ] Clean static analysis (`ruff check` / `eslint`).
